page_title: STU 3-1 KOL | Stuttgart v FC Koln 14/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Today's referee Robert Hartmann rightly decides to book Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) for his harsh tackle.
90+5' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Robert Hartmann has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. Stuttgart are awarded a free kick.

90+2' 3 - 1 Goal! Angelo Stiller displays great vision and sends a pass to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 3:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' A clumsy foul by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln) and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle. Stuttgart earn a free kick.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Tom Krauss leaves the pitch and Fynn Schenten (1. FC Koln) comes on.
89' Lukas Kwasniok prepares a substitution. Eric Martel is replaced by Florian Kainz (1. FC Koln).
85' The attendance for today's match is 60000.

84' 2 - 1 Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) meets a perfect cross from Ramon Hendriks deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the bottom left corner. The score is 2:1.
84' That's the end of the game for Marius Bulter, who is replaced by Denis Huseinbasic (1. FC Koln).
84' Here comes a substitution. Jamie Leweling is given a rest as he is replaced by Tiago Tomas (VfB Stuttgart).
83' Here is a change. Chema Andres is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart).
79' 1 - 1 Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Alexander Nubel with a strike into the left side of the goal. He makes it 1:1.

79' Said El Mala (1. FC Koln) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
77' Sebastian Hoeness has decided to substitute Lorenz Assignon and he is replaced by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart).
77' Substitution. Maximilian Mittelstadt did his best and is replaced by Ramon Hendriks (VfB Stuttgart).
76' That will be a yellow card for one of the players. The one who gets booked is Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart).
76' Robert Hartmann blows his whistle after Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. FC Koln have a free kick.

74' Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again. A free kick is awarded to FC Koln.
73' It looks like Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) saw red with that tackle. Robert Hartmann won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Stuttgart have been awarded a free kick.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Bilal El Khannouss (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Chris Fuhrich.

69' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) has a huge chance to score from close range, but his effort goes just a few inches wide of the right-hand post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.
68' Lukas Kwasniok decides to make a substitution. Joel Schmied will be replaced by Luca Waldschmidt (1. FC Koln).
68' Substitution. Cenk Ozkacar leaves the pitch and is replaced by Said El Mala (1. FC Koln).
67' FC Koln failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
66' Alexander Nubel makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the left-hand post by Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) after a cross from the side.
65' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
63' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
60' Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Robert Hartmann didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
60' Robert Hartmann blows the whistle, Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for a foul. That's a free kick to FC Koln.

59' The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
59' A cross from Sebastian Sebulonsen (1. FC Koln) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
59' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
56' The ball is cleared after Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
55' Good movement by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
53' The foul by Jeff Chabot (VfB Stuttgart) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Robert Hartmann.
53' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
52' Ragnar Ache (1. FC Koln) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Free kick. Stuttgart will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.

51' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Robert Hartmann blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion. A free kick has been awarded to FC Koln.
49' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
47' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
47' A player from Stuttgart commits a rough challenge. Robert Hartmann blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. A free kick has been awarded to FC Koln.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The end of the first half.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
45' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) takes the corner which is cleared.
43' A cross from a corner kick by FC Koln is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

42' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The linesman makes the right call and FC Koln will have a corner.
42' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by FC Koln, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Dangerous play by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart). Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul. FC Koln are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
41' Robert Hartmann interrupts the game. One of the players from Stuttgart won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. FC Koln get a free kick.
40' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.

39' A precise low pass is received by Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for FC Koln.

38' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the roof of the net. However, Alexander Nubel anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
37' FC Koln fail to score from a corner as Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) leaps to collect the ball.

36' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball goes out for a corner. Stuttgart can continue in their attacking effort.
36' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
34' FC Koln have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
33' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
31' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
29' Robert Hartmann shows the yellow card to Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) for a heavy challenge.
29' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) nearly creates a chance, but his attempt to pick out a teammate with a through ball does not come off.
28' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
26' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
25' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.
24' Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln) commits a rough challenge and Robert Hartmann blows his whistle for a foul.
22' Golden chance! Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the left post.
22' Rough tackle by Tom Krauss (1. FC Koln). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
21' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
17' Robert Hartmann couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Joel Schmied (1. FC Koln) and blew his whistle. Stuttgart will take a free kick.
15' 1 - 0 Ermedin Demirovic (VfB Stuttgart) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and scores with aplomb inside the left post. What a beautiful shot.
14' Stuttgart are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
10' Eric Martel (1. FC Koln) commits a foul and Robert Hartmann immediately signals a free kick. Stuttgart have a free kick.
9' Jakub Kaminski (1. FC Koln) receives a precise pass inside the box and takes a shot that flies just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
7' Marius Bulter (1. FC Koln) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
5' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
3' Cenk Ozkacar (1. FC Koln) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the left post, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop the effort.
3' Kristoffer Lund (1. FC Koln) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
2' Jan Thielmann (1. FC Koln) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play and FC Koln have been awarded a corner kick.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The ball is out of play and FC Koln manage to earn a corner.
Robert Hartmann will officiate today.
